resources.string: ES-DE Plus
Configure %1$s
1. Choose storage access. Full file access is recommended so your application data and games survive uninstall. Then choose the application-data folder, followed by the ROM folder.
Use app-owned storage (secondary; deleted on uninstall)
Use direct filesystem compatibility (recommended full file access)

ROM folder: %1$s How to add games: connect USB, install Android platform tools on your computer, enable USB debugging, and authorize the computer. Run adb push your-ROM-folder/. %2$s/ (organize games into system folders such as nes). No storage permission is required. Uninstalling removes app-owned games. Import through a file picker is not available yet.

Compatibility mode requires broad storage access. Choose your application-data folder, then your shared ROM folder after granting access. A SAF selection alone does not provide the native filesystem access this mode needs.
Grant direct filesystem access
Choose shared ROM folder
Selected ROM folder: %1$s How to add games: copy them here with USB file transfer or a file manager, in system folders such as nes.
No folder selected

Access was not granted. Retry or explicitly choose app-owned storage.
All-files settings are unavailable on this device. Choose app-owned storage, or enable all-files access in the device settings and return here.

2. Choose the application-data folder before the ROM folder.

Application-data folder: %1$s 3. Choose a separate ROM folder.
Create or use %1$s for settings, media, gamelists, collections, themes and custom systems? Shared data survives uninstall. No files have been read or written there yet.

Use %1$s in place? Existing settings, custom systems, gamelists, collections, media overrides, theme repositories and custom event scripts take effect. Apps with all-files access and USB/MTP writers can change these contents. Optional Android settings may require capabilities this device lacks. Normal writes and upstream migrations will happen. Concurrent use with another frontend can lose or corrupt changes. Back up this folder and close the other app first. No files have been read or written there yet.
Previous private location: %1$s. No data is automatically copied, moved or deleted between roots. Data left in that private location is deleted on uninstall.

The previous private location is currently unavailable. No private data is copied; it is deleted on uninstall. Restore that volume to access it, or explicitly choose another mounted volume for shared data.
Application-data folder: %1$s. This private data, including settings, media and themes, is deleted on uninstall.
Choose and confirm the application-data folder before continuing. Your existing ROM selection is kept.
Shared application-data folder names cannot contain double quotation marks. Choose a folder without double quotation marks, then review it again.
Application-data and ROM folders must be separate; neither may contain the other.
Existing MediaDirectory override: %1$s. Media stays there; the selected ROM folder remains authoritative.
MediaDirectory points to inaccessible storage: %1$s. Restore this folder or correct MediaDirectory in es_settings.xml, then retry. No replacement media folder will be selected.
Cannot read the selected settings file. Correct es_settings.xml or select another data folder.
Waiting for the frontend to close before restarting…
The frontend could not restart yet. Retry after it closes, or return to your home screen and open the app again. Your games and settings are kept.
